utterances.text: We have one hour before the room is occupied, so let us confirm the setup.
The main microphone is ready, but the ventilation noise is stronger today.
That is useful for the test, as long as we measure the speech level first.
I can record thirty seconds of room tone before anyone moves.
Please do, and note the microphone position.
Should I leave the side microphone running too?
Yes, it gives us a useful comparison.
I am hearing a short click on that channel.
I heard it too. The cable was loose, but it is stable now.
Let us repeat the level check before recording speech.
After that, we should capture a few natural interruptions instead of reading isolated lines.
Fine by me. I will mark the start time and keep the room quiet.
Great. Start the session and save the raw channels.
